intent: A dark, premium studio footer that closes the page with a big line, link columns, a newsletter, a live local clock, and a giant wordmark measured to span the container exactly and cut off above its baseline.

stack.fonts: font-display (Geist, tight tracking), font-sans (Geist), font-mono (Geist Mono)

rows: closing line + large mailto link; back-to-top ring button on the right from md
2px white/15% rule; grid 2 -> 4 (sm) -> 12 (lg): Studio, Work, Elsewhere, Visit (2 cols each) + newsletter (cols 9-12; full row split in two at sm-md)
1px rule; legal line + legal links in mono
fitted wordmark flush to both container edges, cut 14% above the baseline

color.light: white radial 8% from below, hairline top

motion.wordmark: fades in and rises 24px over 0.8s, ease [0.2,0.8,0.2,1], once measured
motion.links: background-size underline grows from the left (300ms); the email underline retracts to the right (500ms)
motion.chips: arrow chips rotate -45deg on hover; back-to-top arrow lifts 4px
motion.newsletter: AnimatePresence mode=wait: form exits up 8px, success pill rises 8px over 0.4s
motion.clock: ticks every second; colon pulses; live dot pings
motion.reducedMotion: no rise, ping or pulse; back-to-top scrolls instantly

responsive.mobile: 2-col link grid, newsletter full width, back-to-top row under the email, wordmark about 50px tall at 390px
responsive.md: back-to-top moves to the right of the closing line
responsive.lg: 12-col grid; legal bar splits left/right; wordmark about 190px tall at 1440px

accessibility: each link column is a nav with aria-label
address element; time element with dateTime
sr-only input label, aria-invalid, polite live error, role=status success
external links marked (opens in a new tab)

content.headline: Got a brief, a hunch or a half-built thing?
content.newsletter: Low Tide: a short letter every other Thursday

avoid: sizing the wordmark with a guessed vw value
equal-weight tiny link columns with no hierarchy
